action_items.item: Roll out feature flag changes on io-shop in stages, with an error-rate check that stops the rollout and turns the flag back off when errors rise.
Require tests that exercise a flag's on path to pass in CI before that flag can be switched on in production.
Link the HighErrorRate alert on io-shop to an on-call rotation so that a person is paged when it fires.

causal_chain.step: Account page requests raised ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47 during {G5309.3}. No such error was logged before then.

ruled_out.what: A deploy or release: none came back from the day of production changes read before the onset.
Another flag change: the flag provider's history showed only one flag change by anyone but Argus in the hour read.

causal_chain.step: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on by admin at {P1.1}. Before that it was evaluated off and account pages rendered normally. Evaluations were split between off and on at {G971b.6} and were all on during {Gce95.4}.
With the flag on, account page requests reached a monthly per-item spend calculation that divides by zero for shoppers with no purchases this month.

input.cause_in_plain_words: Switching on a new monthly spending summary made the account page fail with a division by zero, likely for shoppers who had bought before but not yet this month.

contributing_factors.factor: The flag change reached all account page traffic almost at once: evaluations were split briefly and then all on. No staged rollout or health check that would hold back or undo a flag change was seen.
contributing_factors.had_it_been_otherwise: A staged rollout gated on the error rate would have kept the failures to a small share of shoppers and stopped the change before it reached everyone.
contributing_factors.label: CF-1

contributing_factors.factor: No test of the flag-on path for a shopper with past purchases but none this month was seen before the flag was switched on. Code-Fix says the cases it adds would raise against the current code.
contributing_factors.had_it_been_otherwise: The division by zero would have been caught before the flag was switched on in production.
contributing_factors.label: CF-2

went_well.item: The Investigator Agent tied the onset to the monthly-spend-feature flag change and the ZeroDivisionError log lines, and formed C1.
The Mitigation Agent switched monthly-spend-feature back off. The change can be put back.
The Mitigation Agent watched the service, found it no longer at the incident's level and judged the action confirmed.
The Code-Fix Agent proposed a fix as draft pull request #570 for a person to review.

went_wrong: Nobody was paged: the alert was not linked to any on-call incident.

input.root_cause: With monthly-spend-feature on, `render_spend_summary` calls `average_spend_per_item_this_month` in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py. That function divides the month's spend by the number of purchases flagged `in_current_month` and does not handle an empty list. So for a shopper who has bought before but not this month, it raises ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47, and the boundary in src/io_shop/account_page.py turns that error into a failed page.
input.still_at_risk: Switching monthly-spend-feature back on before a fix is in place could make account pages fail again in the same way.
